classes.name: Product
classes.description: A product or platform, such as Azure Machine Learning, Microsoft Foundry, MLflow, or ONNX.

classes.name: Interface
classes.description: A way to work with the service, such as CLI v2, Python SDK v2, REST API, studio, Bicep, or Terraform.

classes.name: Capability
classes.description: A product feature or practice, such as automated ML, safe rollout, or model data collection.

classes.name: Resource
classes.description: Something you create and manage in Azure Machine Learning, such as a workspace, registry, datastore, or connection.

classes.name: ComputeTarget
classes.description: A compute resource for jobs or endpoints, such as a compute cluster, compute instance, serverless compute, or Kubernetes compute.

classes.name: Endpoint
classes.description: An endpoint type that serves inference, such as a managed online, Kubernetes online, batch, or serverless API endpoint.

classes.name: Deployment
classes.description: A deployment that runs behind an endpoint, such as an online, batch, or pipeline component deployment.

classes.name: FeatureStoreEntity
classes.description: A managed feature store concept, such as a feature store, entity, materialization, or retrieval specification. Relationships among them use part_of, requires, and has_input. (CQ 22)

classes.name: Asset
classes.description: A versioned asset, such as a data asset, model, environment, component, feature set, or flow.

classes.name: DesignerComponent
classes.description: A prebuilt designer component, such as Split Data or Train Model. (CQ 26)

classes.name: PromptFlowTool
classes.description: A built-in prompt flow tool, such as the LLM tool or the Python tool.

classes.name: DataType
classes.description: A data asset or input type, such as uri_file, uri_folder, or mltable. (CQ 21)

classes.name: ModelType
classes.description: A model asset type or format, such as custom_model, mlflow_model, or triton_model. (CQ 11)

classes.name: Framework
classes.description: An ML framework or library, such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, or LightGBM. (CQ 28)

classes.name: Job
classes.description: A job type, such as a command, sweep, pipeline, parallel, Spark, or AutoML job. (CQ 25)

classes.name: AutomlTask
classes.description: An AutoML task type, such as classification, forecasting, or image object detection. (CQ 23)

classes.name: Algorithm
classes.description: A training algorithm or model architecture, such as LightGBM, Prophet, TCNForecaster, or ResNet. (CQ 23, 24)

classes.name: YamlSchema
classes.description: A CLI v2 YAML schema that defines an entity type. (CQ 29)

classes.name: AzureService
classes.description: An Azure service the workspace depends on or integrates with, such as Azure Key Vault, Azure Container Registry, or AKS.

classes.name: SecurityConcept
classes.description: A network or data protection mechanism, such as a managed virtual network, private endpoint, or customer-managed key.

classes.name: IdentityConcept
classes.description: An identity or authentication mechanism, such as a managed identity, service principal, key auth, or Microsoft Entra token.

classes.name: Role
classes.description: An Azure RBAC role, built-in or custom. (CQ 12, 13)

classes.name: Permission
classes.description: An RBAC operation string, such as Microsoft.MachineLearningServices/workspaces/computes/write. (CQ 13)

classes.name: Policy
classes.description: An Azure Policy definition that applies to Azure Machine Learning. (CQ 19)

classes.name: Region
classes.description: An Azure region, such as East US 2. (CQ 8)

classes.name: Limit
classes.description: A quota or service limit with a value, such as "Workspace name, 2-32 characters". (CQ 31)

classes.name: Metric
classes.description: A monitoring signal or metric, such as data drift, prediction drift, or CpuUtilization. (CQ 30)

classes.name: Task
classes.description: A user goal that has prerequisites or ordered steps, such as "attach a Kubernetes cluster" or "perform a safe rollout". (CQ 4, 10)

classes.name: KnownIssue
classes.description: A documented known issue. (CQ 34)

classes.name: ErrorMessage
classes.description: An error message or code that troubleshooting articles explain. (CQ 35)

predicates.name: policy_effect
predicates.description: Audit, Deny, DeployIfNotExists, and so on.

predicates.name: limit_value
predicates.description: The limit as stated in the text, such as "2-32" or "50".

predicates.name: adjustable
predicates.description: True if the limit can be raised through a support request.

predicates.name: supports
predicates.description: Subject works with or enables the object. Prefer a specific subproperty when one fits.

predicates.name: requires
predicates.description: Subject needs the object first. (CQ 4, 13, 14, 16, 30)

predicates.name: part_of
predicates.description: Subject is a component or member of the object. (CQ 22, 27)

predicates.name: replaced_by
predicates.description: Subject is deprecated or retired in favor of the object. Pair with a time condition for the date. (CQ 33)

predicates.name: incompatible_with
predicates.description: Subject can't be used together with the object. (CQ 18)

predicates.name: runs_on
predicates.description: A job type or capability runs on a compute target. (CQ 1, 25)

predicates.name: has_gpu_support
predicates.description: A compute target offers GPU for the given endpoint type or job type. (CQ 2)

predicates.name: pipeline_step_type
predicates.description: A job type can run as a step in a pipeline job. (CQ 25)

predicates.name: deployable_to
predicates.description: An asset or model type can be deployed to an endpoint type. (CQ 9, 11)

predicates.name: hosted_by
predicates.description: A deployment type runs behind an endpoint type. (CQ 6)

predicates.name: accepts_input_from
predicates.description: An endpoint or job reads input from a data type, datastore, or service. (CQ 9)

predicates.name: available_in
predicates.description: Subject is available in a region. (CQ 8)

predicates.name: supports_auth_method
predicates.description: A resource or endpoint accepts an authentication method. (CQ 7, 20)

predicates.name: uses_identity
predicates.description: A resource uses an identity to access other resources. (CQ 14)

predicates.name: grants
predicates.description: A role grants a permission or the ability to perform a task. (CQ 12, 13)

predicates.name: requires_role
predicates.description: A task or operation needs the given role at minimum. (CQ 13)

predicates.name: secures
predicates.description: A security mechanism protects a resource or service. (CQ 16)

predicates.name: encrypts
predicates.description: An encryption mechanism protects a kind of data or resource. (CQ 17)

predicates.name: allows_outbound_to
predicates.description: A network mode or outbound rule allows traffic to a service. Pair with a network_mode condition. (CQ 15)

predicates.name: enforces
predicates.description: A policy constrains a resource or setting. (CQ 19)

predicates.name: backed_by
predicates.description: A datastore or resource is stored in an Azure service. (CQ 20)

predicates.name: uses_algorithm
predicates.description: An AutoML task or capability can use an algorithm. (CQ 23, 24)

predicates.name: supports_task
predicates.description: A capability or component supports an AutoML task type. (CQ 23)

predicates.name: contains_framework
predicates.description: An environment includes a framework. (CQ 28)

predicates.name: has_input
predicates.description: A component, tool, or job takes an input of the object type. (CQ 26)

predicates.name: shareable_via
predicates.description: An asset type can be shared across workspaces through a resource such as a registry. (CQ 27)

predicates.name: defined_by_schema
predicates.description: An entity type is defined by a CLI v2 YAML schema. (CQ 29)

predicates.name: computes_metric
predicates.description: A monitoring capability computes a metric or signal. (CQ 30)

predicates.name: has_limit
predicates.description: Subject is subject to a quota or service limit. (CQ 5, 31)

predicates.name: affects
predicates.description: A known issue or error affects a resource or capability. (CQ 34, 35)

predicates.name: precedes
predicates.description: A task must be completed before another task. (CQ 4, 10)

predicates.name: differs_from
predicates.description: Placeholder link used when the text compares two things (CQ 3, 6). The compared attribute goes in the assertion's conditions or evidence.

condition_types.name: region
condition_types.description: Applies only in listed Azure regions. (CQ 8)

condition_types.name: release_status
condition_types.description: Applies only while in preview, or only when GA. (CQ 1, 23, 32)

condition_types.name: interface
condition_types.description: Applies only through a given interface (SDK, CLI, studio, REST). (CQ 1)

condition_types.name: endpoint_type
condition_types.description: Applies only to one endpoint type. (CQ 7)

condition_types.name: model_flavor
condition_types.description: Applies only to one MLflow model flavor. (CQ 11)

condition_types.name: network_mode
condition_types.description: Applies only in one managed network isolation mode. (CQ 15)

condition_types.name: workspace_configuration
condition_types.description: Applies only with CMK, private endpoints, or another workspace setting. (CQ 18)

condition_types.name: task_type
condition_types.description: Applies only to one AutoML task type. (CQ 23)
